title: ⚠️ Service Outtage
body: Woods Studio Service Outtage may affect Clover Store for Android & Windows. Please expect degraded service, and issues across platforms.

title: Woods Studio E3 App Framework - Expanding for More
body: A brand new build of Clover Store is arriving, plus updates to most of our SDKs, apps, and more. E3 is designed for more power, bridging the gap that we created with Collocal's Platform. E3 will include the Aikumi Playform SDK, which will soon intergrate AIkumi AI into our core services. Store E3.01 will release very soon, but please download (if applicable) Store 1.7 from the Google Play Store for the support to upgrade to the E3 Platform.
